conviction_note: Q1 (Jun-Aug 2026) carried the peak of the aluminium ingot spike: the BOJ import index averaged about 211, +46% on last year's Q1 and above the level implied by the plan's 635 yen/kg full-year assumption. The direct peer LIXIL lost 6.4bn yen YoY in its sash business on aluminium and fell 8% on the day it said so, while 5932 did not move on that read-through. Against this, housing starts rose 6-19% YoY in Jun-Aug and depreciation falls about 16bn yen a year after the impairment, and the company has never revised its guidance at a Q1 print. Lessons rule 1 says the aluminium series is public, so p_up stays near 50 (45). The findings sum to -0.7 and the scaled number is -0.3. The gap is the lessons haircut plus 悪材料出尽くし risk on a known bad quarter.
bar: No consensus or 四季報/IFIS number could be sourced, so the bar is unsourced and every finding is capped small. The reference points are the company's FY2027.05 guide (sales 390.0bn, OP 4.0bn, no H1 guide disclosed; https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589459.pdf) and last year's Q1 OP of -1.164bn yen (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=5932). print_vs_bar_pct is on revenue against a seasonal share (about 24%) of the 390bn plan, roughly 936bn: about in line, with OP progress likely below a straight line.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.68% held by one seller as of 2026-09-29, down 0.03pt, so small and slightly covering (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). The margin ratio (信用倍率) is 20.83 per kabutan on 2026-10-07 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=5932): leveraged retail is crowded long, which is the one setup where a visible miss still finds sellers. There is no option skew. priced_lean_pct is -0.13. Run-up is -1.23% over 20 days and -1.54% over 5. The stock has drifted from 677 on 08-20 to 640.

findings.finding: Q1 FY2027.05 (Jun-Aug 2026) is the peak aluminium-cost quarter. The BOJ aluminium ingot import price index averaged 210.8 (Jun 212.6, Jul 216.4, Aug 203.4), against 144.7 in last year's Q1, when the Nikkei price was 455.2 yen/kg and OP was -1.164bn yen. That maps to roughly 660-700 yen/kg, above the plan's 635 yen/kg full-year assumption. The direct sash peer LIXIL reported on 2026-07-31, after 5932's guide, that its housing technology business swung 6.4bn yen YoY to a core loss on aluminium, and said cost increases continue through Jul-Sep with price benefits only from Oct. So 5932's Q1 OP is likely another loss, with a progress rate against the 4.0bn guide that reads poorly.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's Q1 OP loss (-1.164bn, released 2025-10-07 at 15:30) took the stock from 664 to 629 (-5.27%) the next day and to 598 within four sessions (Yahoo chart). The H1 loss in Jan 2026 was also sold (kabutan: 続落). The Q3 downward revision in Apr 2026 was bought +3.3% (出尽くし).
findings.source_date: 2026-08 index print (BOJ CGPI series page, accessed 2026-10-07); LIXIL release https://newsroom.lixil.com/20260731_q1 dated 2026-07-31; company plan assumption 635 yen/kg in https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589485.pdf dated 2026-07-09
findings.why_not_priced: LIXIL fell 8.0% on 2026-07-31 (1886 to 1735) on its aluminium-driven sash loss. 5932, a purer aluminium building-materials name, went 657 to 653 that day and then rose to 677 by 08-20. If the read-through were priced, 5932 would have marked down with LIXIL rather than rally. Since 08-20 it has given back about 5%, so part of it may now be in. The company gave no H1 guide, so no number has told holders what Q1 looks like.
findings.independence: LIXIL newsroom (https://newsroom.lixil.com/20260731_q1) and the BOJ import index (https://www.kabutore.biz/keizaisihyo/kigyocpi423.html) are separate sources pointing the same way. 5932's own 2026-06-26 revision notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260626/140120260624579061.pdf) says price pass-through in building materials lags (遅効性). Against it: Fuji Sash's Apr-Jun 2026 loss narrowed (-267m vs -469m; https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=5940).

findings.finding: Two offsets the FY plan treats as headwinds or that are mechanical. Japanese new housing starts rose YoY in each of Jun/Jul/Aug 2026 (+18.6%, +8.2%, +6.1%; 3-5 straight months of increases), while the company's own guide says domestic volumes keep falling. Depreciation drops from 9.3bn to a planned 7.7bn after the 16.2bn impairment, worth about +0.4bn per quarter against last year's Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Volume has not been the line this name moved on in the last eight prints; its moves followed OP sign and revisions (baseline history; kabutan headlines).
findings.why_not_priced: Housing starts are public, and sashes ship with a lag after starts, so this is a macro-to-company proxy. The depreciation saving is in the plan. The only unpriced part is that the guide's 'volume decline continues' language looks conservative against the starts series.
findings.independence: The company's own FY2027 depreciation plan (77 vs 93; https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589485.pdf) is a separate source for the depreciation part.

outside_window.finding: Officer share-based remuneration trust: up to 300m yen of 5932 shares to be bought (from treasury stock or on market) over the plan period, about 1.5% of market cap. Timing is not dated inside this window.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely. The company has revised at Q3 (2024-04, 2026-04), at H1 (2025-01) and before year-end (2026-06), never at Q1, and the FY guide was set on 2026-07-09. Returns: none expected, dividend 25 yen held. New-year guide: not applicable. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 OP was 35% of the FY in FY2025.05 and negative in FY2026.05, and this Q1 is likely negative again against a 4.0bn guide.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Converting the Q1 aluminium index into a precise yen/kg Q1 OP shortfall versus the plan
rejected_candidates.detail: Same fact as finding 1. The index-to-Nikkei ratio drifted from 3.11 to 3.33 across years, and last year's Q1 aluminium effect (-1.0bn on a +3.5 yen/kg change) shows hedge and inventory lags, so a precise number would be false precision.

baseline_tension: Mild agreement with a slightly negative priced lean (-0.13) and a flat-to-down run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY guide with commentary that price revisions land from H2 (LIXIL's script), plus 出尽くし on a known-weak quarter. That is why the scaled number is only -0.3 against a findings sum of -0.7. I looked for a buyback or dividend change and found none.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series): the aluminium index and the LIXIL read-through are public, and no forecast or dividend cut is expected to ADD to them. Finding 1 cut from -1.8 to -1.2 and p_up moved from 42 to 45.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension (held guide, H2 price-revision script, 出尽くし). I had already searched for returns, so nothing further moved. abs_move_pct trimmed from 3.2 to 3.0 because no guidance change is expected at Q1.
